PROMPT.label: Replied within half the statutory period

FULL.label: Full disclosure of what was asked, nothing withheld

VOLUNTARY.label: Records released or published without being forced to

LOCATION.label: Free, helpful answer on where a record is held

SUBSTANTIVE.label: Substantive written answer where no statutory clock applies

OVERDUE.label: Overdue: per working day past the statutory deadline (max −150 per request)

PARTIAL.label: Partial: part of what was asked still outstanding after the reply

NOT_HELD.label: "Not held" with no destruction record and no search described

LOST.label: Records said to be destroyed, lost or not surviving, with no destruction record produced

FEE.label: Fee demanded for access (each quote; max −50 per institution)

REPEAT_REFUSAL.label: Refused as a repeated request (FOIA s.14(2))

REDUNDANT_Q.label: Asked us to clarify something the record had already answered

WRONG_REGIME.label: Handled under the wrong regime, or the applicable law not accepted

RAILROAD.label: Reply did not answer the question asked, or diverted it elsewhere

DEAD_END.label: Dead-end mailbox: automated "no longer supported", no action taken

CONTRADICTION.label: The body's own statements disagree, not reconciled in writing

UNANSWERED_LETTER.label: Letter or preservation notice with no reply after 20 working days

EXEMPTION.label: Withheld under an exemption or closed to access

PRIVACY.label: Privacy given as the reason to withhold historic records
